name: Mivne Real Estate (K.D) Ltd
summary: Mivne Real Estate (K.D) Ltd engages in real estate activies in Israel, Switzerland, and France. The company operates through two segments, Income-Producing Real Estate and Residential Real Estate Development. It locates, plans, acquires, develops, constructs, markets, and sells housing units. The company is also involved in development, acquisition, construction, rental, and management of buildings for offices, high-tech, industrial, logistics and commercial purposes, data centres, and housing units.
